Can Lovart fix blurry or shaky video?
Yes. Our AI Agent uses advanced stabilization and upscaling models (like Veo 3's underlying tech) to interpret and reconstruct details, turning shaky HD clips into smooth 4K visuals.
What makes Flux Kontext important for video optimization?
Standard AI video tools often 'forget' what a character looks like as they move. Flux Kontext maintains identity consistency, so your subject doesn't morph into a different person during the video.
Can I turn a static image into an optimized video?
Absolutely. Use our Image-to-Video workflow. Upload a high-quality Nano Banana image, and the Agent will animate it with cinematic motion, effectively 'optimizing' a still into a video asset.
Is this suitable for professional broadcasting?
Yes, Lovart supports high-bitrate exports and upscaling up to 4K, making the output suitable for professional presentations, TV commercials, and high-quality social media content.
Do I need to know how to prompt for video?
No. That's the beauty of the Design Agent. You can just say 'Make this look better and sci-fi', and the Agent will reason through the necessary technical prompts for you.
